title: Zebulon Whateley
wikitext:
[[Image:ZebulonWhateley.png|thumb]]
'''Zebulon Whateley''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Devil's Hopyard]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Lore]]
*+1 [[Will]]

Any Phase: [[Exhaust]] to refresh 1 of your [[Spell]]s.


==Mythos Source==
Zebulon Whateley appears in ''The Dunwich Horror'' (1928), written by H.P. Lovecraft, and is a distant relative of Wilbur Whateley from a branch of the family that was not completely mad.
